title: C&I Market Notices and Fixed-Price Changes in Law
content:
*Scope: Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts. Subject: market notices and changes in law.*

1. Beacon Ridge records on each contract the monthly index price for every delivery month, the capacity price for each June-to-May capacity year and the transmission rate for each calendar year of the facility's zone.
2. A fixed price may change during the term only to pass through a change in law or regulation, only on a structure that allows a regulatory pass-through, and only with a regulatory pass-through notice issued at least the structure's regulatory change notice days, counted in calendar days, before its effective date.
3. Changes in capacity price or transmission rate are not regulatory pass-throughs; they flow only through the pass-through lines of structures that pass those costs through.

## Clause no longer in force

The clause that the new price applies to cycles beginning on or after the later of the stated effective date and the notice date plus the regulatory change notice days is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.

## Notices kept on a contract

| Notice | Issued | Effective date shown | Figure carried |
|---|---|---|---|
| monthly index price | one per delivery month | first day of the month priced | index price, cents per kWh |
| capacity price | one per June-to-May capacity year | first day the capacity price applies | capacity price, USD per MW-day |
| transmission rate | one per calendar year | first day the transmission rate applies | transmission rate, USD per MW-day |
| regulatory pass-through | when a change in law or regulation is passed through | the stated pass-through date | new contract price, cents per kWh |

## Points of judgement

- A rise in the capacity price for a new capacity year is not a change in law: it reaches the bill only through the capacity charge line of a structure that passes capacity through, and it never changes a fixed price.
- A fixed price on a structure that does not allow a regulatory pass-through does not change during the term for a change in law or regulation.

superseded_clauses: the new price applies to cycles beginning on or after the later of the stated effective date and notice_date plus regulatory_change_notice_days.
